name: ts-monorepo
description: Template for setting up a TypeScript monorepo

scripts.test: pnpm run fmt && pnpm run -r test
scripts.lint: pnpm run fmt && npx eslint --ext js,ts,tsx .
scripts.fix: pnpm run fmt && npx eslint --fix --ext js,ts,tsx .
scripts.publish:check: pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/utils run build && pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/utils pack --dry-run && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=12288 pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/psy-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/psy-sdk pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/contract-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/contract-sdk pack --dry-run
scripts.publish:utils: pnpm run version:patch:utils && pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/utils publish --access public --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ --no-git-checks
scripts.publish:psy-sdk: pnpm run version:patch:psy-sdk && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=12288 pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/psy-sdk publish --access public --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ --no-git-checks
scripts.publish:contract-sdk: pnpm run version:patch:contract-sdk && pnpm --filter @psy-protocol/contract-sdk publish --access public --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ --no-git-checks
scripts.publish:all: pnpm run publish:utils && pnpm run publish:psy-sdk && pnpm run publish:contract-sdk
